questions.question: What do the nations and peoples do in Psalm 2?
options: Bow down low and worship the one and only true God
Rage and plot in vain against the LORD and his Anointed
Bring tribute and costly gifts to the city of Jerusalem
Flee away in terror from the coming day of judgment
questions.answer: Rage and plot in vain against the LORD and his Anointed

questions.question: What does the LORD declare about the king on Zion?
options: 'You are my Son; today I have begotten you'
'Before the mountains were born, you are God'
'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want'
'I will praise you, O LORD, with my whole heart'
questions.answer: 'You are my Son; today I have begotten you'

questions.question: The psalm warns the kings to serve the LORD with fear and to 'kiss the Son.'
He who sits in the heavens _____ at their plotting.
Blessed are all who take _____ in him.
